summary: Validated 3 new features: (1) kill-marker icons (weapon field on kill events), (2) non-blocking queue toast in Lobby, (3) placement match streak (2x RP first 5 matches, no losses). 8/8 new feature backend tests pass and frontend lobby flow verified end-to-end with a fresh registration.

minor.issue: TestHealth::test_root_health (existing test_shooter_backend.py) expects 'players_online' key but endpoint now returns casual_players/ranked_players. Pre-existing test schema mismatch, NOT a regression from new features.
TestLeaderboardAndProfile::test_leaderboard_sorted_desc expects kills-desc but leaderboard appears sorted by rank_points. Pre-existing test mismatch, not a regression.
TestWebSocket::test_two_clients_see_each_other_shoot_kill_persists and TestBotsActivelyShoot are flaky (timing/bot AI). Pre-existing, unrelated to new features.

action_items: (Low) Update legacy test_shooter_backend.py::TestHealth and TestLeaderboardAndProfile assertions to match current API schema (casual_players/ranked_players, sort by rank_points).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:957 last_match_end_payload is only set briefly before broadcast and immediately broadcast; the field is nulled after 10s intermission. Tests need to capture it concurrently — works for live clients receiving the WS frame but means clients reconnecting mid-intermission still have access via this field (correct intent).

server.py:937 - placement_matches_played $inc happens inside the same update as rank_points $set; this is atomic and idempotent per match, but note the value used for is_placement is read BEFORE increment, which is correct.
Hud.jsx kf-row testid uses k.weapon || 'ak47' fallback, and Game.jsx maps k.melee->'katana'. Good defensive defaults.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_placement_weapons_queue.py (new test file, 8 tests covering placement fields in auth, queue endpoints, kill weapon field, end_match placement RP logic)

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8 new tests pass); legacy regressions: 26/30 overall
success_rate.frontend: 100% (placement badge, queue toast, ranked disable, kill-feed weapon icon all confirmed)

test_credentials: Registered fresh users prefixed with TEST_pl_/TEST_endm_/TEST_neg_/TEST_fe_ during tests; admin@shooter.com/admin123 unused.

context_for_next_testing_agent: New feature tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_placement_weapons_queue.py. Run with: python -m pytest backend/tests/test_placement_weapons_queue.py -v. Frontend verification: register a fresh user → /lobby shows PLACEMENTS 0/5 + 2x RP badge next to BRONZE 0 RP rank badge; click RANKED MATCH → queue-toast appears bottom-right (~1527,940 in 1920x1080), ranked button shows 'IN QUEUE...' disabled. queue-cancel restores. Casual game kill-feed renders kf-row-ak47 with kf-weapon-ak47 icon when bots kill each other. Legacy TestHealth/TestLeaderboard failures are pre-existing schema/sort assertion drift, not caused by this iteration.
rca of the issue: N/A — all new features verified working.
